name: PD 171 was established by Ordinance No. 18161, passed by the Dallas City Council on February 8, 1984. Ordinance No. 18161 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 18161; 25508)
source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 171 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text: SEC. 51P-171.101.LEGISLATIVE HISTORY. PD 171 was established by Ordinance No. 18161, passed by the Dallas City Council on February 8, 1984. Ordinance No. 18161 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 18161; 25508)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text: SEC. 51P-171.102.PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE. PD 171 is established on property generally located along both sides of Josephine Street, between Worth Street and Victor Street. The size of PD 171 is approximately 4.117 acres. (Ord. Nos. 18161; 25508)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-171.103.DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.
(a)Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.
(b)Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25508)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-171.104.DEVELOPMENT PLAN. Development of the Property must comply with the city plan commission-approved development plan (Exhibit 171A). (Ord. Nos. 18161; 25508)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text: SEC. 51P-171.105.USES. Uses are limited to single-family uses. (Ord. Nos. 18161; 25508)

sections.title: Density
sections.text: SEC. 51P-171.106.DENSITY. Development is limited to a maximum of 57 lots. (Ord. Nos. 18161; 25508)

sections.title: Development Standards
sections.text: SEC. 51P-171.107.DEVELOPMENT STANDARDS. Maximum permitted building height is 24 feet. Front yard setbacks and lot widths must be provided as shown on the approved development plan. All other standards for development on the Property are the same as the standards for the TH-2 Townhouse-2 District contained in the Dallas Development Code. (Ord. Nos. 18161; 25508)

sections.title: Homeowners’ Association
sections.text: SEC. 51P-171.108.HOMEOWNERS’ ASSOCIATION. A homeowners’ association must be established to maintain all open areas. (Ord. Nos. 18161; 25508)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text: SEC. 51P-171.109.GENERAL REQUIREMENTS. Development must comply with all codes and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 18161; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text: SEC. 51P-171.110.PAVING. All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 18161; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text: SEC. 51P-171.111.COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS. The building official shall not issue a certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there is full compliance with this article and with the construction codes and all other applicable ordinances of the city. (Ord. Nos. 18161; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text: SEC. 51P-171.112.ZONING MAP. PD 171 is located on Zoning Map No. J-8. (Ord. Nos. 18161; 25508)
